relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: chondrocyte-expressed Nav1.7 regulates chondrocyte biology and OA progression

relationships.subject: DRG neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: deletion of Nav1.7 in DRG neurons reduced DMM-induced pain without affecting structural abnormalities such as cartilage destruction

relationships.subject: TNF
relationships.evidence_quote: SCN9A expression was significantly induced by TNF and IL-1β

relationships.subject: Nav1.7 blockers
relationships.evidence_quote: increased intracellular Ca2+ signals are essential for the enhanced secretion of HSP70 and midkine induced by Nav1.7 blockade in chondrocytes

relationships.subject: carbamazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: CBZ, a sodium channel blocker currently in clinical use, prevents cartilage loss in animal models of OA

key_findings: Nav1.7 is the only upregulated VGSC in OA cartilage and human OA chondrocytes express functional TTX-sensitive, ProTx II-sensitive Nav1.7 currents.
Chondrocyte Nav1.7 regulates OA progression whereas DRG Nav1.7 mediates OA pain; Nav1.7 blockade is chondroprotective via Ca2+ signalling and secretion of HSP70 and midkine.
